rationale: For a politician transparency platform, the design must communicate truth, authority, and objectivity. A high-contrast Swiss-inspired brutalist layout with thick borders and sharp typography achieves an 'editorial' or 'audit' feel. The rawness signals unvarnished truth.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict grids. Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) to prevent text collision with the mandatory heavy borders.
spacing_and_layout.public_directory_grid: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetrical grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-px bg-black (creates thin borders between items).
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px to 2px solid black borders on almost all structural elements.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-none (Sharp corners to reinforce the strict, objective theme)

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-bold rounded-none border-2 border-transparent hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-black font-bold rounded-none border-2 border-black hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors

components.cards: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-none shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] p-6
components.inputs: rounded-none border-2 border-black focus:ring-0 focus:border-primary focus:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#002FA7] transition-all bg-white
components.tables: w-full border-collapse. th: bg-surface_alt border-b-2 border-black font-bold text-left uppercase tracking-wider text-xs p-4. td: border-b border-neutral-300 py-4 px-4 font-mono text-sm.
components.tabs: flex border-b-2 border-black. Tab items: uppercase tracking-wider font-bold px-6 py-3 -mb-[2px] border-b-2 transition-colors. Active: border-primary text-primary. Inactive: border-transparent text-neutral-500 hover:text-black.
components.charts: Recharts. Use sharp straight lines (type='linear' or 'step'), not curved ('monotone'). High contrast stroke colors: Black for baseline, Primary Blue for net worth, Red for liabilities.

public_directory.layout: Hero section with large typographic statement and abstract architecture image overlay. Search bar massive, dominating the viewport. Politician cards in a masonry or offset grid.
public_directory.politician_cards: Include headshot, name (H3), state/party, and a 'View Record' brutalist button.

politician_profile.header: Split layout. Left: Large high-res portrait. Right: Brief intro, key stats in a heavily bordered bento grid.
politician_profile.tabs_section: Overview (text-heavy), Wealth History (Line chart + Data Table), Relatives (Nested accordions or sub-tables with their wealth history).

auth.layout: Minimalist center-aligned card. White card, thick black border, hard shadow.
auth.social_buttons: Disabled state: grayscale, opacity-50. Must include a tooltip on hover explaining 'Currently disabled'.

super_admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (dark or very light gray with black borders). Main content area dense.
super_admin_dashboard.features: Signup approvals queue in a table with distinct Accept/Reject buttons. Reference Data (Countries/States/Cities) managed via inline-editable tables or compact dialogs. Audit Log with complex filters.

admin_dashboard.features: Politician CRUD with multi-step form or long scrolling form with sticky save bar. Image upload area styled as a dashed-border dropzone. Wealth history entered via dynamic form arrays.

motion.hover: Instant or very fast (100ms) transitions. Avoid bouncy spring animations. Go for snappy, mechanical feel.
motion.page_load: Fade-in with a subtle slide-up (duration 300ms, ease-out).

heroes_and_backgrounds.description: White concrete building under blue sky

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. Examples: `data-testid='search-politician-input'`, `data-testid='view-record-button'`, `data-testid='wealth-history-tab'`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. Apply custom fonts (Archivo, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono) in the Tailwind config.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Archivo.
Build the dashboard layouts using a grid with gap-px and a dark background to create 1px 'borders' between panes, or use explicit border-r/border-b classes to enforce the brutalist style.
For the social login buttons on the Auth page, wrap them in a Tooltip from Shadcn, and style them to look disabled (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed).
Never use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use the media URLs provided in this JSON.
Build robust charts using Recharts for the Wealth History section. Emphasize sharp, straight lines over smooth curves to maintain the Swiss Brutalist aesthetic.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, form inputs, and tab triggers.
